async def act(page):
    # Extract the license text from the code elements in the main content
    license_text = ''
    code_elements = page.get_by_role('code')
    count = await code_elements.count()
    for i in range(count):
        text = await code_elements.nth(i).text_content()
        license_text += text + '\n'
    # Remove trailing newline if any
    license_text = license_text.strip()
    return license_text
